question: What salutation and epithet should be uttered to the Siddhi Mātṛkās?
premises: Obeisance is directed to all Siddhi Mātṛkās.
The practitioner should utter this formula.
inference: One should say 'obeisance to all Siddhi Mātṛkās, ever-risen.'
plain_english: One should say: 'Obeisance to all Siddhi Mātṛkās, ever-risen.'
